label: Strict no-self-giving from efficient priority and a causal-sense bridge
meaning: Non-transcription cross-family conditional support for the new no-self-giving prerequisite of the BEGINS_2 causal Arrival B route. The same F.PriorSimply used by the supplied efficient-cause-priority and no-self-priority principles excludes any EfficientlyCausesIn c c r via the existing checked SelfCausationPriority.noSelfCauseFromPriority theorem. The open cross-sense bridge says any hypothetical strict GivesAt v c c t would instantiate that forbidden efficient self-edge at F.esse. Therefore strict time-indexed self-giving is absent throughout the accessible histories. READING: the bridge drops the history and moment indices, so EfficientlyCausesIn is read world- and time-neutrally, and the reused premise e078f07b is used under that reading (whatever is in some history an efficient cause of x is simply prior to x, with the unindexed PriorSimply); this is stronger than the here-and-now gloss of definition 69c0b23e. 32d77f18 concerns only PriorSimply and is unaffected. Passing from the being-giving family (GivesAt, definition 158301bc; CAUSE_OF_BEING, disambiguation 88a8fba7; CAUSING_AN_EFFECT, c3c01e92) to efficient causing is done only by the explicit premise 0e961fde on the self-edge; the existing efficient-esse bridge DistinctActualEsseCauseIsEfficient (8934912c) covers only causes distinct from their effect. No efficient-cause/perfection-cause identification, temporal-priority inference, independent argument for the old priority premises, proof of an actual giver or direct God-existence inference is asserted. A structural control shows why the bridge cannot be silently omitted.
